name: es31-ssbo-std430
title: Shader storage buffers and std430
summary: Shader storage blocks read and written by compute, vertex and fragment shaders: a CPU std430/std140 layout calculator compared with glGetProgramResourceiv(BUFFER_VARIABLE: OFFSET, ARRAY_STRIDE, MATRIX_STRIDE, IS_ROW_MAJOR, TOP_LEVEL_ARRAY_SIZE/STRIDE) and with data moved in both directions (CPU-packed data verified by a compute shader, compute-written data compared with the calculator's image), deliberately wrong layouts whose effect is predicted member by member, runtime-sized last members whose length() follows glBindBufferRange offset and size, the indexed SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDING/START/SIZE state, limits, link-time limit experiments and defined errors.
spec: ES 3.2 §7.8 Shader Buffer Variables and Shader Storage Blocks
ES 3.2 §7.6.2.1 Uniform Buffer Object Storage, §7.6.2.2 Standard Uniform Block Layout (std140 rules, std430 differences)
ES 3.2 §7.3.1 Program Interfaces (BUFFER_VARIABLE, SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK, GetProgramResourceiv properties, Table 7.2), §7.3.1.1 Naming Active Resources
ES 3.2 §6.1.1 Binding Buffer Objects to Indexed Targets, §6.6.1 Indexed Buffer Object Limits and Binding Queries (Table 6.5)
ES 3.2 §6.3 Mapping and Unmapping Buffer Data, §7.11.2 Shader Memory Access Synchronization (glMemoryBarrier)
ES 3.2 chapter 21: implementation-dependent limits MAX_*_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCKS, MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE, MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDINGS, SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_OFFSET_ALIGNMENT
GLSL ES 3.10 §4.3.7 Buffer Variables, §4.1.9 Arrays (runtime-sized arrays, length()), §4.4.4 Uniform and Shader Storage Block Layout Qualifiers

api.glDispatchCompute: compute shaders fill the Result flags, write the 16-member block and the runtime-sized arrays; every result is read back and compared
api.glBindBufferBase: shader storage binding points 0-3: the compute, vertex and fragment shaders see the bound buffers; BINDING reads the buffer, START/SIZE read 0 afterwards; index >= MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDINGS -> INVALID_VALUE; buffer 0 unbinds
api.glBindBufferRange: four ranges of one buffer at SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_OFFSET_ALIGNMENT-aligned offsets: length() of the runtime-sized array and the bytes the shader wrote follow the range; START/SIZE read back; offset 1, size 0, index >= MAX -> INVALID_VALUE and the binding is unchanged; a negative offset is checked (XFAIL on Mesa)
api.glGetIntegeri_v: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDING of bound, unbound and out-of-range indices (INVALID_VALUE)
api.glGetInteger64i_v: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_START and SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_SIZE after glBindBufferBase/Range; out-of-range index -> INVALID_VALUE
api.glGetInteger64v: MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE >= 2^27 and used to build the at-limit and over-limit link experiments
api.glGetIntegerv: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_OFFSET_ALIGNMENT, MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDINGS, MAX_COMPUTE/VERTEX/FRAGMENT/COMBINED_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCKS against the spec minimums; the general SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER_BINDING equals the bound buffer
api.glGetProgramInterfaceiv: SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK and BUFFER_VARIABLE interfaces: ACTIVE_RESOURCES (2 and 19), MAX_NAME_LENGTH (7), MAX_NUM_ACTIVE_VARIABLES (18)
api.glGetProgramResourceIndex: buffer variables ("Probe.farr[0]", "Probe.pairs[0].a") and blocks are found by name; "Probe.pairs[1].a" is not active (top-level arrays of structures are listed by their first element only)
api.glGetProgramResourceName: the names of all listed buffer variables equal the calculator's names
api.glGetProgramResourceiv: BUFFER_VARIABLE: OFFSET, ARRAY_STRIDE, MATRIX_STRIDE, IS_ROW_MAJOR, ARRAY_SIZE, TYPE, BLOCK_INDEX, TOP_LEVEL_ARRAY_SIZE, TOP_LEVEL_ARRAY_STRIDE of 18 variables in std430 and std140 equal the CPU calculator; SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK: BUFFER_BINDING, BUFFER_DATA_SIZE, NUM_ACTIVE_VARIABLES, ACTIVE_VARIABLES, REFERENCED_BY_*_SHADER
api.glMapBufferRange: MAP_READ of the shader-written buffers (blocks, flags, runtime-sized arrays, canaries) returns the values the compute shaders stored
api.glUnmapBuffer: returns TRUE for every read mapping
api.glBindBuffer: SHADER_STORAGE_BUFFER general binding for uploads and mappings
api.glBufferData: initial and re-specified block data (observed through the compute shader's flags and the buffer images)
api.glUniform1i: u_write switches the compute shader between VERIFY and WRITE; u_cell is the width of the grid cells the fragment shader draws
api.glUniform1ui: u_expect_mask: the members each wrong-layout row is predicted to verify; the fragment shader colours green/magenta/red from it
api.glUniform1f: u_height_scale: the vertex shader's bar heights are probed in the framebuffer
api.glGetUniformLocation: u_write, u_cell, u_expect_mask, u_height_scale are active
api.glDrawArrays: fullscreen triangle per grid row: the fragment shader reads the flag buffer; every cell centre is probed
api.glDrawArraysInstanced: one instance per element of the runtime-sized array: the vertex shader reads values[] and values.length(); every bar is probed
api.glViewport: one viewport per grid row and per bar band
api.glClear: COLOR_BUFFER_BIT; unused areas keep the clear colour
api.glClearColor: background pixels equal the clear colour
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of grid cells and bars
api.glLinkProgram: a compute shader with exactly MAX_COMPUTE_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCKS blocks links, one more does not; a block of MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE bytes links, 4 bytes more does not
api.glCompileShader: COMPILE_STATUS of the compute, vertex and fragment shaders used

visual_review.notes: Viewed gpu es-max (build/debug/test-results/es31-ssbo-std430_gpu_es-max.png, 256x256; llvmpipe and zink captures identical in the earlier direct runs). Top 64 px verification grid with 1-px dark cell borders: rows 0 and 1 (std430 and std140, correct packing) are 16 green cells each; rows 2 and 3 (wrong layout) show 4 green cells (members 1-4) followed by 12 magenta cells, no red cell. Below, three 48-px bands of bars drawn by the vertex shader: 32 narrow bars (8 px), 16 bars (16 px) and 4 wide bars (64 px), heights following 1+(7i) mod 13 (tall pink/grey bars, short green ones for value 1-2); the 4-bar band has two tall bars (values 8 and 9) at x 64-127 and 192-255. The lowest 48 px are intentionally empty (background).
